entries.7f2828c8503700ba: Since April 2025, the company has been implementing its medium-term management plan, 'Chukei 86' (fiscal years ended March 2026 to March 2028), whose basic policies are 'further improvement of profitability in the domestic construction business' and 'expansion of the overseas construction business'. In Japan, the company is working to speed up customer response, strengthen its human resources and expand its civil engineering business; overseas, it is expanding its branch network and strengthening its earnings base. For the final fiscal year, it targets construction business revenue of ¥127.0 billion and an overseas business ratio of 35% or more.
